facts.about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration  . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS  .

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 101% of PAT

business.summary: Persistent Systems provides software product engineering and digital transformation services. It generates revenue through IT services, including application development, testing, maintenance, and infrastructure support across various industries like BFSI, healthcare, and hi-tech.

segments.name: BFSI
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 50,932.99 Million in FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Healthcare & Life Sciences
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 37,721.65 Million in FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Software, Hi-Tech and Emerging Industries
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 58,829.85 Million in FY 2025-26.

guidance.statement: We want to be in the 16 to 17% range, that is our aspiration.
guidance.quote: So, from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

guidance.statement: We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.

guidance.statement: We are confident of maintaining our growth in the existing Persistent part of it.
guidance.quote: we are very confident, first, about maintaining our growth in the existing Persistent part of it

guidance.statement: We believe we can maintain the margins and better them.
guidance.quote: So, long answer, but to summarize, we believe we can maintain the margins and better them.

guidance.statement: The transaction is expected to be Reported EPS accretive in Year 1.
guidance.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.

guidance.statement: We are marching towards the $2 billion run rate by FY27 steadily.
guidance.quote: The $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

guidance.statement: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
guidance.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.

guidance.statement: We remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027.
guidance.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

guidance.statement: Laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.
guidance.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

guidance.statement: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
guidance.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.

scorecard.promised: Aspiration to maintain a 16% to 17% range through FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Margins fell to 14% in Sep 2026, missing the target range.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins dropped from 19% in Mar 2026 to 16% in Jun 2026 and 14% in Sep 2026.

scorecard.promised: Marching towards a $2 billion run rate by FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue reached ₹4,664 cr in Sep 2026, approximately $2.2 billion annualized run rate.
scorecard.evidence: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹4,664 cr exceeds the quarterly requirement (~₹4,200 cr) for a $2bn annual run rate.

scorecard.promised: Expect deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.
scorecard.delivered: Pending; management has secured 94.04% of share capital as of Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: The horizon (Q4-CY26) is current; 94.04% acceptance exceeds the 50% + 1 share threshold.

scorecard.promised: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
scorecard.delivered: FY26 Net Profit of ₹1,865 cr on strong operating performance.
scorecard.evidence: While ETR isn't explicitly in NUMBERS, FY26 PAT grew 33% YoY, supporting the operational guidance period.

scorecard.promised: Confident of maintaining growth in the existing Persistent business.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 30.2% YoY in Sep 2026, showing accelerating momentum.
scorecard.evidence: YoY growth increased from 25.1% in Mar 2026 to 30.2% in Sep 2026.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully accelerated top-line growth toward its $2 billion goal but has significantly compromised margin discipline to get there.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Margins were impacted by annual wage hikes and large deal investments.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins collapsed from 19% in Mar 2026 to 14% in Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: AI technology should be margin neutral or accretive.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins have trended downward since the AI-driven margin improvement claim in Q3 FY26.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Growth in intangible assets will slow as tools reach maturity.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Analysts continue to push back on the increase in intangible assets as of Q2 FY27.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, reaching 30.2% YoY in Sep 2026 compared to 20.1% two years prior.
Strong cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow at 101% of PAT, totaling ₹1,767 cr in FY26.
Successful $2 billion run rate achievement ahead of the March 2027 aspiration deadline.
bear: Operating margins have sharply deteriorated to 14%, well below the 16-17% aspirational floor.
High client concentration with the top 10 customers accounting for 41.6% of total revenue.
Cash conversion cycle has worsened to 83 days from 69 days three years ago.
watch: EBITDA margin recovery toward 16% floor following the 180bps wage hike impact.

claims.claim: We have secured 94.04% of Nagarro share capital and intend to squeeze out remaining minority shareholders upon closing.
claims.quote: We have secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital excluding treasury shares at the expiry of the additional acceptance period, significantly exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 50% + 1 share.

claims.claim: Our Software Reinvention offering helps software companies deliver AI-native products and modernize legacy products for an AI-first world.
claims.quote: Our Software Reinvention offering is designed to help software and technology companies deliver AI native products as well as modernize their legacy products for an AI first world.

claims.claim: Margins were impacted by annual wage hikes, lower utilization, and increased amortization from large deal investments.
claims.quote: This is the quarter when we have the yearly wage hike coming into effect. This impacted our margins by 180 basis points. Lower utilization led to a 20 basis impact.

claims.claim: This is an expansion play bringing together complementary people, capabilities, and markets.
claims.quote: This is not a consolidation play. This is an expansion play for us bringing together, as Anand rightly pointed out, people, capabilities, markets which are all complimentary to us

claims.claim: The new $125 million annual deal cements Persistent's growth streak.
claims.quote: This, in our investors mind, should cement the growth that we have seen in Persistent for the last several years and should continue our 24 quarter streak of growth for times to come.

claims.claim: Integration will be a planned execution over time, leveraging Nagarro's existing management.
claims.quote: Obviously, it will be a planned execution of integration over a period of time and usually these things have to slow roll.

claims.claim: We do not expect much of a seasonality because of AI initiatives.
claims.quote: So, we do not expect much of a seasonality because of that. It will be basically a part of our scaling up the AI initiative.

claims.claim: Using AI technology should be margin neutral or accretive.
claims.quote: And most of these things should be margin neutral or accretive because if we use technology, we should be able to do more work with lesser people and more technology.

claims.claim: The strong growth in India this quarter was an aberration due to billing classification.
claims.quote: The India part is an aberration. The thing that happened there is one of our IT customers in our erstwhile Accelerite business, the renewal happened in rupee (INR) terms through their GCC.

claims.claim: AI platform and tool-driven pricing models contributed to a 150 basis point improvement in margins this quarter.
claims.quote: Couple of engagements of this nature, which we signed in the last quarter and which are now scaling up, have contributed to an improvement in margin by 150 basis points.

claims.claim: New labor codes caused a one-time 230 basis point EBIT margin impact; future provisioning will follow these codes.
claims.quote: In addition, there was a one-time impact of 230 basis points on EBIT margin on account of increased provisioning for gratuity and leave encashment in accordance with the New Labour Code.

claims.claim: Growth in intangible assets will slow as tools reach maturity; revenue generation justifies the capitalization.
claims.quote: I think so it has, they are now at a pretty good amount of maturity level whereby the growth in these intangibles will not be at the same level as what you have seen in the past.

risks.text: Company seeks recovery of INR 21.12 Million in deposits from the IL&FS Group.
North America contributes 81.4% of total revenue, indicating high geographical concentration risk.
Top 10 customers account for 41.6% of total revenue, representing significant client concentration.
